digest.component_or_area: Plan-review gate blocking configuration and T10 DET overlay
propositions: T3 and T10 criteria must transition from non-blocking (zero-LLM artifact) to blocking-postured with 0.90 block_threshold to filter actionable findings from the existing 2,500+ non-blocking runs

T10 class scoping via severity guidance (MAJOR-class only: destructive apply, wildcard grant, plaintext secrets, unauthenticated internet services) prevents lower-priority findings from reaching 0.90 threshold without new Pass-3 machinery

T10 DetGateRule overlay (infra-vocabulary regex matching terraform, cloudformation, Kubernetes, IAM, GitHub Actions, etc.) must fire on infrastructure and GHA workflow plans and skip non-infra plans with det_gated coverage tracking
Pinned test assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py and test_impact_model_versioning.py must be updated to reflect T3/T10 as approved blocking criteria alongside their new routing table entries
